result.reason: The Services licence is appropriately extended to Affiliates and contractors, and transfer and breach-based revocation are addressed by reference to Section 13.3. However, Section 13.3 permits revocation or suspension of “a licence” for specified breaches without excluding the paid-up licences declared irrevocable in Section 13.2. That conflict means paid-up licences are not unambiguously irrevocable as required. Section 13.3 should expressly apply only to subscription licences, or expressly carve out the paid-up licences under Section 13.2. The changes are otherwise limited and preserve unrelated commercial terms.
